## Change and purpose

Describe the public benchmark change and why it is needed.

## Verification

List exact commands and results, including affected metric or run-card checks.

## Rights and privacy

- [ ] External material has a documented source and reuse basis.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, provider account data, customer material, or non-public outputs are included.

## Claim boundary
